definitions.explanation: question word used with the counter {冊|さつ} to ask about the quantity of bound volumes such as books, magazines, and notebooks

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何冊|なんさつ}⟦{読|よ}みました→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many books did you read?

examples.japanese: ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何冊|なんさつ}⟦{買|か}います→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many notebooks will you buy?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何冊|なんさつ}⟦{出|で}ています→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many volumes of this manga have been released?

notes:
COUNTER QUESTION:
{何冊|なんさつ} combines ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what/how many) with the counter ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ for bound volumes.

OBJECTS COUNTED WITH {冊|さつ}:
- {本|ほん} - books
- ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧ - magazines
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧ - notebooks
- ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ - manga volumes
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧ - dictionaries
- ⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧ - albums (photo albums)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧ - one book
- {二冊|にさつ} - two books
- {三冊|さんさつ} - three books
- {何冊|なんさつ} - how many books?

RELATED COUNTER QUESTIONS:
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧ - how many (flat objects)
- {何部|なんぶ} - how many copies (of a publication)
- {何巻|なんかん} - what volume number
